description: Golden feed-reading cases, asserted by core/test/feed.test.js and reproduced by the iOS client's UpdateFeed.swift (mobile/ClawTests/UpdateFeedParityTests.swift). Each case is a fetched feed document and the build reading it: `newer` is the version newerVersion(document, current) must return, or null when the banner must stay absent. `throws` marks the one case a feed version this build cannot parse must throw on rather than silently suppress. This is the contract that keeps the two clients reading one feed the same way.

cases.name: a newer dev build is announced
the same build is not newer, so nothing is announced
an older feed build is not newer
a higher dev count is newer whatever the sha
a stable release is newer than the dev build heading towards it
a dev build is not newer than the release it heads towards
a document naming no version announces nothing
an empty version string announces nothing
a version with surrounding whitespace is read
extra fields the build does not know are ignored
a feed version this build cannot parse is a surfaced fault
